_comment: Every expectation here is something a person wrote down. Nothing is inferred from the
builder, because inferring it from the builder would only re-read the mistake.
Declare only what you mean: a section you leave out is not checked, and the report says so
rather than counting it as a pass.
Lengths are in microns. This example describes a ridge waveguide in a film, on cladding, on
substrate, with an air trench on each side of the core.
Only for a topology-optimised run, and only when you actually have one. The name must be
the name of a real structure: declaring a region that does not exist is a FAIL, not a skip,
because a guard that may stop measuring wherever it is told would be silenced by naming a
With a region declared, the stack and profile are measured on a cut OUTSIDE it, where the
drawn film survives, and the report names the cut it used.
_design_region_example.name: design_region
